brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

verdict.what_happens: The initially tilted first domino falls under gravity and knocks down the other nine in sequence. The chain reaches domino10 at 0.85 s, and all ten settle by about 1.16 s. At 6 s, every domino is at rest and tilted approximately 73–90 degrees from upright.

usage.text:
The first domino starts tilted 12° and falls under gravity, contacting domino2 at 0.13 s. The chain continues in order, reaching domino10 at 0.85 s, and all ten settle by about 1.16 s.

At 6 s, every domino is at rest and tilted well beyond 15° from upright: domino1 is approximately 75° from upright, domino2–domino9 are about 73–74°, and domino10 is flat at 90°. The scene meets the brief.
